item.description:
NeoMount 1.10.8

  • 主窗口支持搜索、折叠侧栏及内嵌偏好设置。连接表单与设置卡片使用相同底色。
  • 启动时自动挂载可统一开关，手动暂停的连接保持暂停。
  • 后台发现新版时在菜单栏、偏好设置及获准的系统通知中提醒。
  • 手动退出时可以立即结束应用，尚未完成的操作可能中断。

English

  • Search connections, collapse the sidebar, and open Preferences inside the main window. Forms now match the settings cards.
  • Control startup mounting with a global switch. Manually paused drives stay paused.
  • See available updates in the menu bar panel, Preferences, and optional macOS notifications.
  • Quitting manually can now interrupt an operation in progress.

NeoMount 1.10.7

  • 手动关闭的连接会保持暂停。重新启动 NeoMount、Mac 唤醒或网络恢复时，应用会跳过这些连接。
  • 再次打开连接开关即可解除暂停。卡片会显示该连接的启动自动连接状态。

升级后，请把不想自动连接的条目再关闭一次。旧版的手动暂停状态无法迁移。

English

  • Manually disconnected drives stay paused after relaunch, wake, or network recovery.
  • Switch a connection back on to resume it. Its card shows the current launch status.

After updating, switch off any drives you want to keep paused. Earlier versions did not save this state.

NeoMount 1.10.6

  • 新增挂载目录可读性检查，失效连接会显示原因，并提供“重新连接”。重连先正常卸载旧卷，磁盘忙时不会强制断开。
  • 打开访达前检查磁盘状态，读取失败时在应用内说明原因。
  • 偏好设置的外观卡片新增语言选择：跟随系统、简体中文、English，重新打开应用后生效。
  • 缩小菜单栏图标与应用图标的硬盘主体，保留连接数量角标大小。

English

  • Checks mounted directories for readability and offers Reconnect for unavailable connections. Reconnection waits for a normal unmount; busy disks are never forcibly disconnected.
  • Checks the disk before opening Finder and explains read failures in the app.
  • Adds System, Simplified Chinese and English choices under Preferences → Appearance. Reopen the app to apply a language change.
  • Reduces the drive artwork in menu bar and application icons, keeping the count badge unchanged.
